Ice Lore +8: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 8% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Insightful Impulse +26: Passive: +26 Insight bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +2: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
